NGA.note: Document reports AI-generated photos in the register but names no rule, authority or enforcement on AI harms.

facts.fact: INEC's ICT director Lawrence Bayode says the Commission has deployed AI-powered chatbots where people ask questions and the AI answers, for public enquiries and logistics support.

NGA.note: INEC chatbots are general administration, not a sector system.
Document names no AI model, dataset or computing built in Nigeria.

facts.fact: INEC's preliminary register of voters, held in its voter registration system database, stands at over 103 million registered citizens, per INEC chairman Joash Amupitan.
INEC displayed the preliminary register at registration areas between 9 and 15 October 2026 for public scrutiny, and also displayed it online, drawing more than 4,800 claims and about 600 objections.

NGA.note: Only a plan for IDP electoral inclusion; no registration or digital service stated.
